correctness.rationale: Fix k and independent embedded one-dimensional elephant increment sequences Y_i; the random selector clocks N_i(n) are multinomial and independent of embedded sequences. The pathwise identity A_i(n)=kT_i(N_i(n))+R_i(n), with R_i=Σ(1-k1_{I_t=i})X_i(t-1), captures the held spins exactly. The selector conditional bracket has diagonal k-1 and offdiag -X_iX_j; Escobar Parra Theorem 5.3 bounded-observable weak law makes the offdiag averages vanish. Bounded jumps give the martingale functional CLT; conditioning on entire embedded sequences gives asymptotic stable independence via deterministic limiting quadratic variation. Uniform LLN for clocks and existing one-dimensional elephant FCLTs yield diffusive √k G_α + √(k-1)W, critical √(kt)N, superdiffusive k^{1-α}t^α L, independent over i. Second-moment recurrence gives E L²=1/[(2α-1)Γ(2α)]. Independent exact selector bracket checks for k=2..6 and large-m recurrence verify finite identities but not functional tightness.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate indicated identities; unrestricted assertions are supported by proof reconstruction, not by finite tests.
